title: Toddler Linda on Her 2nd Birthday, 1953 B&W Deckle Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
14 of april 1953
Lindas Birthday
2 years old.

Hi ya nana

description: A charming full-length outdoor portrait captures two-year-old Linda on April 14, 1953, celebrating her birthday. Wearing a puffy white dress and matching toddler boots, she poses outside an entryway next to an adult wearing a pleated skirt and 1950s peep-toe heels. The reverse features an affectionate note addressed to 'Nana'.
